What the record shows

CoreWeave reported a $60.7 billion revenue backlog in an April 2026 SEC filing 3 and expects to end 2026 with 1.85 GW of data center capacity 4. Between April and October it raised debt through notes, convertible notes and a term loan 3,5 and announced its first sites in Asia-Pacific and India 6,9.

Dated Signals

Oct 7, 2026Converge Digest

Enters India with AdaniConneX

CoreWeave plans a 240 MW AI cloud deployment at the AdaniConneX Taloja campus in Navi Mumbai, its first footprint in India 9.

Oct 8, 2026SiliconANGLE

Willow picks CoreWeave for training

Willow Care, maker of the Willow Voice dictation app, chose CoreWeave for model training 10.

Oct 2, 2026Converge Digest

CoreWeave Forge

CoreWeave launched Forge, a development environment connecting model training, inference, observability, evaluation and post-training 8.

Sep 18, 2026Data Center Dynamics

Customer at Blockfusion, Niagara Falls

Blockfusion signed CoreWeave as a customer at its Niagara Falls, New York campus 7.

Aug 11, 2026The Stack

Q2: revenue and net loss both double

CoreWeave doubled both revenue and net loss in Q2 as debt reached $35 billion, and raised its year-end capacity expectation from 1.7 GW to 1.85 GW 4.

Aug 10, 2026Converge Digest

$2.6 billion delayed-draw loan

CoreWeave closed a $2.6 billion delayed draw term loan facility 5.

Aug 4, 2026Converge Digest · DCD

First Asia-Pacific sites, in Indonesia

CoreWeave announced three Indonesian facilities scheduled for 2028, its first data center presence in Asia-Pacific; DCD reports 360 MW of capacity 6.

Apr 9, 2026SEC (Form 8-K exhibit)

$4.25 billion debt offering

CoreWeave raised $4.25 billion through $1.25 billion of senior unsecured notes and $3 billion of convertible notes, and reported a $60.7 billion revenue backlog 3.
